title: Start here
summary: Choose HyperCore for exchange data and signed actions, or HyperEVM for Solidity contracts, then use the SDK for your language.

links.description: Start here for HyperCore REST and WebSocket endpoints, network URLs, and the maintained SDK list.
Use Hyperliquid's reference Python implementation for queries, orders, API wallets, multisig, and signing behavior.
Use the community TypeScript client for typed HTTP, WebSocket, and exchange actions across Node, Deno, Bun, and React Native.
Use this community Rust client for typed HyperCore actions, streams, precision handling, and selected HyperEVM integrations.
Configure chain 999 for mainnet or 998 for testnet and understand HyperEVM's gas, block, and RPC differences.
Read HyperCore through L1Read precompiles and submit supported actions through the CoreWriter system contract.
